mainText:
Good evening. Weather in Prishtina: 12 degrees now, broken clouds. Next 24 hours: high 17, low 8.

Argentina national team narrows list for Lionel Messi's iconic number 10 jersey to just Lautaro Martinez and Nico Paz.

Grand Theft Auto VI is set to launch on November 19 and will be playable on Xbox Cloud Gaming from day one, after becoming the most pre-ordered game ever on Microsoft Store.

Switzerland has poured about 1.26 billion Swiss francs into highway and national road maintenance this year, with 91 % of the network rated as good or acceptable.

Kosovo opposition deputy Janina Ymeri accused Prime Minister Kurti's government of failing to secure electricity, naming former ministers Martin Berisha and Vuk Hamović as responsible.

A woman recorded a luminous, lantern-shaped object hovering near a U.S. military base in Alaska before it vanished within minutes, describing it as a possible UFO.
